caption: A block held against the hill under the soldier terrain backstop: 48 Spearmen stand with their front rank's slots 2 wu inside the hill's one-body-radius margin. The front rank stays on the margin's edge with no jitter, no man enters the hill, and the centre slides 2 wu off the hill and stops (verified by state dump). With the bodies at rest the render now idles instead of rewriting the block every tick; that half is not visible on screen and is covered by unit tests.
